_about: Grid Paper Editorial variant: ref rank 74 (rabinn.fx, 'ma'): minimal white landscape canvas, small red serif/sans lines, very few objects, long calm holds (the space is the point).

director.rhythm: Slow: picture changes every ~4-6 s; long calm holds on white pages; one object per page at most.
director.pages: Paper-heavy and slow: the speaker stays CUT OUT on a white page (ground beat, paper white) for almost the whole reel, ~6 picture changes/min; one long ground beat, at most one quiet collage page. Trained: this plan scored 32.0 vs 20.3 for the base page plan.
